title: Residue basis and a prescribed minimal generator of a regular-sequence ideal
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring, with residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$. Let $b\ge0$ and let $z_1,\ldots,z_b\in\mathfrak m$ be an $R$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Put $I=(z_1,\ldots,z_b)$. The classes of the $z_i$ form a $\kappa$-basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module] of $I/\mathfrak mI$, where $\mathfrak mI$ is the product ideal regarded as a submodule of $I$. More precisely, the conormal coordinate isomorphism $(R/I)^b\longrightarrow I/I^2$, $(a_i)\longmapsto\sum_i a_i z_i$, induces the coordinate isomorphism $\kappa^b\longrightarrow I/\mathfrak mI$ after quotienting by $\mathfrak m/I$. Every finite generating list of $I$ has at least $b$ entries. For every $x\in I\setminus\mathfrak mI$, one has $b\ge1$, and there are $z'_2,\ldots,z'_b\in I$ such that $[x],[z'_2],\ldots,[z'_b]$ is a $\kappa$-basis of $I/\mathfrak mI$ and $I=(x,z'_2,\ldots,z'_b)$. No regularity of this replacement list is asserted. If $b=0$, $I=0$ and $I/\mathfrak mI=0$; the prescribed-element assertion has no instances.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-regular-sequence-conormal-free] to the given regular sequence. It gives the coordinate isomorphism $\phi:(R/I)^b\xrightarrow{\sim}I/I^2$ sending $e_i$ to $z_i\bmod I^2$, including $b=0$.

Since $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$, $I^2\subseteq\mathfrak mI$. The image under $\phi$ of $(\mathfrak m/I)(R/I)^b$ is exactly $\mathfrak mI/I^2$: both are sums of classes of $a z_i$ with $a\in\mathfrak m$. Thus quotienting $\phi$ by these submodules gives $\kappa^b\xrightarrow{\sim}I/\mathfrak mI$. Explicitly both successive quotients identify representatives modulo $\mathfrak m$ in each coordinate, respectively modulo $\mathfrak mI$ in $I$; the map remains $(\bar a_i)\mapsto\sum a_i z_i\bmod\mathfrak mI$. This proves both the residue basis and its asserted compatibility with conormal coordinates.

proof.text: If $y_1,\ldots,y_r$ generate $I$, reducing their expressions for elements of $I$ modulo $\mathfrak mI$ shows that their classes span $I/\mathfrak mI$ over $\kappa$. Apply [lem-sfb-independent-family-spanning-cardinality] to the independent family $([z_i])_{i=1}^b$ and the set $W=\{[y_1],\ldots,[y_r]\}$. It gives $b\leq|W|\leq r$, even when the generating list has repetitions.

proof.text: The $R$-module $I$ is finitely generated by $z_1,\ldots,z_b$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators] with $A=R$, $M=I$ and the list $x,z'_2,\ldots,z'_b$ whose residues span by Step 4. It yields $I=(x,z'_2,\ldots,z'_b)$. This asserts no regularity of the new list. For $b=0$, the empty list generates $I=0$, its residue module is zero, and there is no $x\in I\setminus\mathfrak mI$.

lean.statement: theorem regularIdeal_residue_basis_prescribed_generator (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (b : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) (z : Fin b → I) (hI : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (z i : R))) = I) (hz : ∀ i : Fin b, (z i : R) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hreg : IsRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i ↦ (z i : R)))) : (∃ (c : Module.Basis (Fin b) (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (v : Module.Basis (Fin b) (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (I ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I)))), (∀ i : Fin b, c i = I.toCotangent (z i)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin b, v i = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I)).mkQ (z i)) ∧ ∃ q : I.Cotangent →ₗ[R] (I ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I))), (∀ x : I, q (I.toCotangent x) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I)).mkQ x) ∧ Function.Surjective q ∧ LinearMap.ker q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I.Cotangent) ∧ (∀ a : Fin b → R, q (c.equivFun.symm (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk I (a i))) = v.equivFun.symm (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (a i)))) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (y : Fin r → R), Ideal.span (Set.range y) = I → b ≤ r) ∧ (∀ x : I, (x : R) ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R * I → 1 ≤ b ∧ ∃ (w : Fin b → I) (v : Module.Basis (Fin b) (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (I ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I)))), (∀ i : Fin b, i.val = 0 → w i = x) ∧ (∀ i : Fin b, v i = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I)).mkQ (w i)) ∧ Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (w i : R))) = I) ∧ (b = 0 → I = ⊥ ∧ Subsingleton (I ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R I))))
